crossRefs.note: So Haman came in. The king said to him, “What shall be done to the man whom the king delights to honor?” Now Haman said…
crossRefs.keyword: What shall we do. Heb. What to do

people.name: Ahasuerus
people.line: Persian Emperor (probably Xerxes I); husband of Esther

people.name: Vashti
people.line: Queen of Persia, deposed by King Ahasuerus (Xerxes)

translations.web: “What shall we do to the queen Vashti according to law, because she has not done the bidding of the King Ahasuerus by the eunuchs?”
translations.bsb: “According to law,” he asked, “what should be done with Queen Vashti, since she refused to obey the command of King Xerxes delivered by the eunuchs?”
translations.kjv: What shall we do unto the queen Vashti according to law, because she hath not performed the commandment of the king Ahasuerus by the chamberlains?
translations.asv: What shall we do unto the queen Vashti according to law, because she hath not done the bidding of the king Ahasuerus by the chamberlains?
